name: Flaying Spider Venom
body:
Price 100 gp (liquid)

ABOUT

Harvested from venomous spiders, this poison is an inexpensive but seldom-lethal means of debilitating an enemy.

DETAILS

Type poison (injury); Save Fortitude DC 11; Onset 1 round; Frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; Cure 1 save

EFFECT

1d3 Con
